headline: Türk Telekom Reports Rise in Third-Quarter Revenue to 86.4 Billion Liras
summary: Türk Telekom announced its consolidated revenues increased by 11.9 percent year-on-year to 86.4 billion Turkish Liras in the third quarter of 2026.
why: Türk Telekom is a major telecommunications and digital services provider in Turkey, reflecting broader consumer and enterprise demand trends in the region.

impacts.name: Türk Telekom
impacts.why: Double-digit revenue growth points to stronger financial performance for the telecom operator.
